name: bookipi
description: Run your business from chat — invoices, customers, expenses, deals, proposals, eSign contracts, meetings, reports and your website. Installs the Bookipi skill; pair it with the `bookipi` CLI or a Bookipi MCP connector.

interface.shortDescription: Run your small business from chat
interface.longDescription: Run your business from chat. Invoices and the whole invoice document family (estimates, credit notes, delivery notes, purchase orders), customers and payment history, expenses and receipt scanning, deals, AI-written proposals, eSign contracts, recorded meetings with transcripts and AI summaries, reports and dashboards, and your Bookipi website. Installs the Bookipi skill — presentation rules, operation routing, and 21 flow playbooks (morning brief, collections run, win a deal, quick quote, stalled-deal recovery, website review). Sign in with your Bookipi account; no install and no API key. Add the `bookipi` CLI for writes.
defaultPrompt: Create an invoice for Acme — $5,000 consulting.
